articleTitle: Effects of UWB Electromagnetic Pulse on UAV Data Link System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In respect to the influence of ultra wide-band electromagnetic pulse on unmanned aerial data link system, an electromagnetic effect test was carried out, the influence law was obtained, and the protection suggestions were given. First, the intensities of ultra wide-band radiation field at different distances were measured. Then the corresponding relationship between electromagnetic environment and fault phenomenon of data link system was obtained under different radiation field intensities, different repetition frequencies and different data link states. Experimental data show that the data link system, as the hardcore of unmanned aerial vehicle, is susceptible to strong electromagnetic pulse interference. Front door coupling is the main coupling path for the interference to unmanned aerial vehicle's main remote control data link, so it is necessary to install protection module on RF front-end to improve the anti-damage capability. The back door coupling phenomenon is also serious, so shielding, grounding and filtering methods must be comprehensively adopted for total security.

articleTitle: Improved Step Detection and Step Length Estimation Based on Pedestrian Dead Reckoning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In the indoor environment, the Global Positioning System (GPS) cannot provide accurate location information due to the complexity of the internal structure of buildings and the interference of indoor equipments. Pedestrian Dead Reckoning (PDR) is an indoor positioning method that relies on smartphone carrying sensors (such as accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer) without requiring additional equipments. The intense electromagnetic interferences caused by indoor electronic equipments have serious influences on the accuracies of indoor location. This paper presents an improved step detection and counting method based on PDR. There is continuity in the walking process. In order to make full use of this feature, this paper firstly filters and differential processes the acceleration data obtained from the smartphone, then uses the improved peak detection algorithm to detect and count the steps. This paper compares two algorithms of step length estimation, and presents an improved step length estimation algorithm based on differential acceleration data. As a result, this paper improves the accuracies of both step number detection and step length estimation.

articleTitle: Influence of Microwave Pulse Power on The Burnout Effect of The AlGaN/GaN HEMT in a LNA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The influence of microwave pulse power on the burnout effect of the AlGaN/GaN high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) in a low noise amplifier (LNA) is studied. The LNA constructed by an AlGaN/GaN HEMT is modeled by using our independent-developed device-circuit joint simulator. The correctness of our simulator is verified by comparing the simulated DC characteristics of the studied HEMT by using our simulator and two kinds of commercial software. The simulated gains obtained by using our simulator and the commercial software ADS are in agreement with the measured results. The results show that the relationship between the injected power and the actual absorbed power satisfies a linear relationship, and the burnout time decreases with the increase of the injected power.

articleTitle: Capacitive Diaphragm for Compartment Shielding in the Fifth-Generation Radio Frequency Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This work proposes a compartment shielding method for the fifth-generation (5G) radio frequency (RF) systems. In this method, a small capacitive impedance surface is vertically placed in a shielding box as a diaphragm. Benefitting from the large phase shift on the capacitive impedance surface, it would introduce strong transverse resonance and exhibit a good shielding performance with only half height of the package. The simulation results show that this approach realizes above 10 dB shielding effectiveness (SE), covering two of the 5G working bands (24.5-27.5 GHz and 26.5-29.5 GHz). This method is helpful for reducing the size of conventional diaphragms and releasing design space in the miniaturized systems.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition of Wireless Modulation Signals Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Wireless modulation signal pattern recognition is widely used in military and civilian applications. This paper proposes a method based on deep learning for wireless modulation signal pattern recognition for many types in practical applications. In this paper, a 34-layer convolutional neural network is designed to identify 16 typical wireless modulated signals. The robustness of the recognition algorithm is improved by using various methods. The data is enhanced by means of interpolation and extraction, power normalization, Gaussian noise, etc. The feature information matrix is constructed by extracting the time domain, frequency domain and phase domain information of the signal by Hilbert transform. The Additive Margin Softmax [1] method is used to make the signal have larger inter-class spacing and smaller intra-class spacing. Experiments show that under the condition of 0dB signal-to-noise ratio, the recognition rate can reach more than 95%, which is better than the traditional machine learning algorithm.

articleTitle: A Broadband Planar Spiral Antenna for Electromagnetic Environment Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of miniaturization, wide frequency band and low-profile antennas for electromagnetic environment monitoring area, we designed a miniaturized Archimedes spiral antenna for USRP electromagnetic signal acquisition system. Antenna is sine-wave meandered based on the traditional Archimedean spiral antenna to reduce the antenna size. After optimizing the structure parameters, the antenna with a radius of 60mm and a thickness of 2mm was fabricated. The measurement results show that: in 400MHz-4.5GHz frequency range, the antenna has good impedance characteristics with VSWR ≤ 2, and has an ultra-wide-band, as well as great directivity and omnidirectional radiation feature. Finally, the antenna was applied to the USRP(Universal Software Radio Peripheral) and an environmental monitoring experiment was conducted. The results show that the antenna can receive electromagnetic signals of 400MHz-4.5GHz, and has potential application in electromagnetic environment monitoring area.

articleTitle: Study On The Power Limiter Under Strong Electromagnetic Field Of Beidou Navigation Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: For Beidou navigation receivers, high power microwaves under strong electromagnetic fields may cause their RF front-end amplifiers to break down or even be damaged, so it is necessary to protect their RF front-ends by adding a power limiter to the front end. This paper designs a PIN diode high power limiter for the characteristics of the Beidou navigation receiver. It uses a two-stage limiting circuit structure to increase the power capacity of the power limiter to 30dBm. And it ensures that the insertion loss of the power limiter is less than 1.5dB by using PIN diodes with smaller junction capacitance and QFN package structure. In addition, it adopts a circuit structure of applying forward direct-current bias voltage to the PIN diode, which can reduce the threshold power of the power limiter to less than 0 dBm. Power limiter test results show that the power limiter has an insertion loss of 1.2 dB at the operating frequency, a threshold power of 0 dBm, and a power capacity of 31 dBm. The experimental results are consistent with the design specifications, which proves the feasibility of the power limiter circuit.

articleTitle: Modeling Two-element Antenna Array with Random Phase Errors using Analytic, Monte Carlo and Polynomial Chaos Expansion Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: For a two-element antenna array with random phase errors, the array factor and maximum beam direction are related to the phases. We can get the analytic solutions of the array factor and maximum beam direction and verify them with many Monte Carlo simulations. In this paper, polynomial chaotic extension (PCE) is used to construct the experimental design and obtain an alternative model for the antenna array factor and maximum beam direction with random phase errors, while reducing the number of operations. The results obtained by PCE were compared with analytical solutions and Monte Carlo simulation results to verify the method.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Study on Frictional Charge Law of Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The surface electrostatic discharge effect occurs when the aircraft is flying at high speed. In severe cases, it will interfere with the normal operation of the communication and navigation system and pose a threat to the safe operation of the aircraft. Therefore, it is significant for evaluating the electrostatic safety of the aircraft to study the electrostatic discharge of the aircraft surface. Based on the flight environment of the aircraft, this paper conducts theoretical analysis and experimental research on the frictional electrification law of the aircraft surface, and obtains the frictional polarity and charge law of the aircraft. Studies have shown that when the surface material of the aircraft collides with particles in the air such as ice crystals, gravel, raindrops, etc. the surface material is negatively charged, while the ice crystals are positively charged; when these particles are rubbed against the sand, except for the PTFE material with negative charge, other material is positively charged; the difference between the frictional electrification current of the aircraft and the ice crystal and the equivalent work function of the two sides of the contact, the ice crystal concentration in the cloud, the equivalent cross-sectional area of the aircraft and the flight speed are linear. The research results can provide technical support for aircraft electrostatic safety assessment and electrostatic protection design.

articleTitle: Enhancement Objective Q-Learning MAC for Emergency Transmission
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The emergency occurrences are unpredictable. In these circumstances, the successful transmission of emergency data is important to wireless sensor networks. We propose enhancement objective Q-Learning MAC (eOQ-MAC) for emergency transmission, which is characterized by its normal-time-slot & emergency-time-slot superframe and enhancement objective Q-Learning. In eOQ-MAC, one node can also use emergency time slots, even when it has no emergency data. However, when one node has emergency data to transmit, then it autonomously uses emergency time slots. If there are data collisions in emergency time slots, the nodes with no emergency data leave their emergency time slots. This previous process is realized by enhancement objective Q-Learning. From a superframe perspective, this is good to improve the reliability of emergency transmission, while simultaneously ensuring each node's fairness and enhancing the utilization rate of emergency time slots. The packet loss rate of eOQ-MAC is lower than CSMA/CA's 79.6%, S-MAC's 79.7%, and ALOHA-Q's 48.9%, only for emergency data transmission. In this paper, the emergency transmission is the enhancement objective of our proposed Q- Learning. Due to various circumstances, the enhancement objective of our Q-Learning should be modified to extend its applications.

articleTitle: Research on electrostatic discharge induced by electromagnetic pulse based on electromagnetic field test system in space radiation environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field refers to the electrostatic discharge process of spacecraft surface materials, cables, some special structural parts and other areas with low charging potential induced by strong electromagnetic field. In general, the spacecraft surface low charge potential sensitive area of the electric field is weak, electron energy is lower than the ionization energy of molecules, atoms, collision ionization probability is low, when the strong electromagnetic field action, stimulate low-pressure gas to produce dense plasma, thereby reducing the discharge threshold and induce the generation of electrostatic charge discharge. The establishment of testing method for electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field is the premise of research on law and protection method of electrostatic discharge induced by strong electromagnetic field. At present, there are no experimental conditions for the interaction between strong electromagnetic field and space environment in China. Therefore, this article established the strong electromagnetic radiation environment and space radiation environment at the same time, under the action of induced discharge test system, not only to be able to carry out electrostatic discharge, high power microwave, nuclear electromagnetic pulse, ultra-wideband electromagnetic pulse and continuous wave such as strong electromagnetic field radiation studies, but also need to solve the high vacuum environment at the same time for sample production and discharge, the discharge parameters and the effect of real-time monitoring, etc., at the same time, based on the experiment system, carry out the static electromagnetic pulse radiation field induced by needle - ball electrode test, has obtained the good experimental effect, for the research on the rules of space equipment of strong electromagnetic field induced electrostatic discharge is of great significance.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Security of Cooperative Network with Machine Learning-based Relay Selection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: We explore the potential of machine learning for relay selection in a cooperative multi-relay wiretap network with decode-and-forward (DF) protocol, aiming to enhance the physical layer security. Such network is divided into two scenarios according to whether the channel state information (CSI) of wiretap links is available or not for source, when it is assumed that the CSI of the main links has been known at the source. In addition, two machine learning-based schemes, namely, the convolutional neural network(CNN)-based multi-classifier and the support vector machine(SVM)-based multi-classifier, are proposed to characterize the conventional optimization problem of cooperative relay selection as a multi-classification problem in two scenarios mentioned above. In our study, we provide more insight into the spatial correlation of CSI and make the first attempt to introduce the CNN for relay selection in a cooperative multi-relay wiretap network. Finally, the simulation results indicate that two machine learning-based with relatively low selection complexity and less feedback amount achieve substantially the same secrecy performance as the conventional selection scheme.

articleTitle: Research on AES Cryptographic Chip Electromagnetic Attack Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Cryptographic chip is an important carrier for implementing cryptographic algorithms. Its side channel leakage seriously threatens information security, which has attracted extensive attention from researchers and business circles around the world. In this paper, the AES-128 cryptographic algorithm is used as the attack object implemented by the commonly FPGA cipher chip. The electromagnetic radiation detection is the main test method while the deep learning method is applied to the side channel attack. For traditional template attack method, its shortcoming is that the plaintext or ciphertext must be known. Combined with the “divide and conquer” approach, we proposed a nibble attack method that targets the key directly. This method can not only reduce the number of templates that need to be built, but also reduce the computational complexity. At the same time, this method can use more training data. For the problem of time-consuming training and large samples collection, transfer learning is used to assign initial weights to the training model. In this way, we fixed the AES-128 plaintext and keys and collected its electromagnetic data, in order to obtain an ideal template to transfer the deep learning situation to the specific case which the keys and plaintext are random to improve deep learning speed and accuracy of key attacks. The experimental results show that the recovery rate of the attack model to the nibble key can reach 77.13% while it has increased 9.47%. compared with the direct training. Besides, the training process is reduced by about 40 rounds, and the speed is increased by nearly 40%.

articleTitle: A Planar Dual-Wideband Bandpass Filter with Multiple Transmission Poles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A planar microstrip dual-wideband bandpass filter (BPF) with multiple transmission poles is presented in this paper. The transmission zeros and transmission poles are analyzed and calculated according to the even- and odd-mode network analysis theory and transmission line theory. A prototype with eight transmission poles was designed, fabricated, and measured. The measurement results are consistent with the simulation results, which verifies the design method. Finally, a dual-wideband bandpass filter with fractional bandwidths of 94.1 % and 27.8 % was realized. The return loss is greater than 15.6 dB in the first passband and greater than 14.5 dB in the second passband.

articleTitle: Temperature rise test method of hot bridgewire EED under steady conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, the temperature rise method of the hot bridgewire electro-explosive device (EED) under the steady conditions is proposed. The optical fiber temperature test technique is employed. Since the measurement range of the temperature is limited for this technique, the extrapolation method is used. The relationship between the injected current (or the field strength) and the temperature rise of the bare bridgewire is analyzed and validated by experiment. The work in this paper is the basis for proposing the high-level field radiated susceptibility test methods of the systems containing hot bridgewire EED in the future.

articleTitle: A 3-4.5 GHz Electrically Reconfigurable Bandpass Filter Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filter with continuously tunable center frequency and tunable bandwidth (BW). The filter is based on combline SIW resonators loaded with varactors to tune the center frequency. Surface mount varactors between two coupled resonators control the inter-resonator coupling and tune the bandwidth. The varactors are also used to load the feedline to adjust the external coupling at different frequencies and bandwidths. A two-pole electrically reconfigurable bandpass filter is designed, simulated and optimized. The filter shows a 3 dB BW range of 82-260 MHz around 4.5 GHz, a 3 dB BW range of 40-170 MHz around 3.5 GHz and a 3 dB BW range of 75-90 MHz around 3 GHz with return loss better than 10 dB. The insertion loss range from 0.5 dB to 2 dB over the whole tuning range.

articleTitle: Side Channel Attack of Lightweight Block Cipher Simeck Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Simeck32/64 algorithm is a lightweight encryption algorithm have no replacement and substitution operation. Therefore, in this paper, under the condition that intermediate value information and plaintext ciphertext are unknown, only get electromagnetic leakage data of the copy of the equipment of, we use these data trained a deep learning model of to attack the last 48bit simeck 32/64, so as to realize a “blind” gray box bypass electromagnetic attack algorithm based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Effect of ESD on Beidou Navigation Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of the Beidou system, the Beidou navigation receiver begins to be widely used, but due to the low power of navigation signal, the navigation receiver is easily disturbed and cannot work normally. This paper take Beidou navigation receiver as experiment object, and study the sensitive voltage and effect under the condition of ESD, The experiment shows that the positioning function of the receiver is not affected by ESD, but the data output serial port is susceptible to interference, so that the upper computer cannot obtain the effective information of navigation and positioning in time. The conclusion provides a basis for the electromagnetic protection of the navigation receiver.

articleTitle: A Broadband Dual-Polarized Planar Antenna for LTE/5G Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband dual-polarized antenna with high isolation and gain is proposed for LTE/5G base stations. The dual-polarized antenna consists of two perpendicular ± 45° coplanar dipoles and it is fed by two coaxial cables. The antenna also includes two square rings, four metal cylinders and a reflector. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the dual-polarized antenna is 44.1% (2300-3600MHz) and the isolation between the two polarization ports is greater than 25dB when the return loss is greater than 15dB. The half-power beam width of the dual-polarized antenna is about 60 ± 50, and the gain of the antenna increases gradually from 8.5dB to 11dB. The proposed antenna achieves broadband, dual polarization and high radiation efficiency, and it has simple structure. It is suitable for LTE/5G base station applications. Detailed antenna structure and simulation results are given in this paper.

articleTitle: A High Gain Patch Antenna Based on Zero Refractive Index Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: We propose a high gain planar antenna based on zero refractive index metamaterials. Using the S-parameter retrieval methods, the metamaterial structure realized the zero refractive index at 12.8 GHz. The simulation of the antenna with the optimized superstrate show that the zero refractive index metamaterial has a converging effect on the beam, which enhance the directivity of the planar antenna. It is demonstrated that, the gain of antenna with zero refractive index metamaterials is about 1.5 dB higher than that without the zero refractive index metamaterials.

articleTitle: A Multi-frequency Complementary Fractal Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Fractal structures are widely used in microstrip antennas because they can improve antennas' performance due to their self-similarity characteristic. A new kind of complementary hexagon fractal microstrip antenna is designed in this research. The results show that the proposed microstrip antenna presents multi-frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on in-band EMC test method of RF receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The sensitivity of radio frequency (RF) receiver to in-band electromagnetic interference signal is an important parameter. At the equipment level, anti-interference data of the receiver are generally obtained by conducted susceptibility test. At the system level, electromagnetic compatibility between the RF receiver and the system is evaluated by measuring the radiated interference level within the receiver band.

articleTitle: Status and Analysis of 3GPP 5G NR Base Station EMC Specification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The 3GPP RAN4 group has published the EMC specification TS 38.113[1] for 5G NR base station, which is the first public published 5G base station EMC specification all over the world. This TS 38.113 is a key guidance and reference for 5G base station EMC test. So far the latest version is TS 38.113 v15.6.0. The major difference of this new specification compared to legacy ones are the introduction of Active Antenna System known as AAS. The radiated emission, radiated immunity test hence have different requirements and test method. Other EMC test are also fully influenced on test set-up and test configuration. In this paper, the status of current TS 38.113 is updated and the major difference stated above have been fully analyzed.

articleTitle: Mie scattering coefficient of electromagnetic waves by charged sphere particle
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The electromagnetic wave scattering characteristics of charged particles are studied by the principle of electromagnetic wave scattering. The relationship is derived between scattering coefficient and scale parameters, and another relationship is derived between scattering coefficient and surface conductivity. Under different surface conductivity and different scale parameters, the difference of electromagnetic scattering between particles in neutral and charged states is calculated and compared. The difference in coefficients. The calculation results show that the scattering coefficient changes greatly with the increase of surface conductivity, but when the surface conductivity reaches a certain value, the scattering coefficient tends to be constant; as the surface conductivity increases, the scattering coefficient becomes larger.

articleTitle: Research on Induction Lightning Protection for Vehicle Platfornn
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: With more and more electronic equipment and devices installed inside a vehicle, the on-board vehicle platform has become one of the systems can easily affected by lightning. When the lightning directly strike to the vehicle platform or strike near to the vehicle platform, the vehicle platform will definitely generate induced lightning effects through conduction, induction and coupling effect in the vehicle's electronic system, and generate overvoltage to damage the electronic devices inside the vehicle platform. Based on the situation, this paper analyses the influence of induced lightning overvoltage on the internal electronic equipment and devices of vehicle platforms, and discusses its protection methods, in wish of providing some ideas for the induction lightning protection of vehicle platform.

articleTitle: A Tri-polarized MIMO Antenna with Diverse Radiation Properties for the 5G-V2X Vehicual Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a tri-polarized MIMO antenna with diverse radiation properties for the 5G-V2X vehicular communication is proposed. The design consists of an omnidirectional monopole unit and two pairs of loop radiator dipoles. By loading eight pairs of double inverted L-shaped elements, the directional dipoles get wide-beamwidth characteristic for both E-plane and H-plane. Moreover, the larger inverted L elements lower the elevation angle of the main radiative direction of the monopole, which results in gain enhancement in the azimuth plane. For the directional cross-dipoles unit, two impedance bands reach 34.36% and 19.62% (VSWR<; 2). The half power beamwidths (HPBW) are 99° and 100° in E-Plane and H-Plane at 3.5 GHz, 119° and 95° in E-Plane and H-Plane at 4.9GHz, respectively. As for the omnidirectional monopole, it operates in 5.68-5.96 GHz (4.8%) with the gain of 2.50 ± 0.59dBi in the azimuth plane.

Author Keywords: gain enhancement in the azimuth plane

articleTitle: Passive Intermodulation of Metallic Contact in Radiation Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In order to evaluate the passive intermodulation (PIM) level induced by metallic contact structure located in the radiation field near the receiving antenna, a calculation method for predicting the amplitude of PIM received by the antenna is proposed and demonstrated in the paper. Adopting the PIM point source model, and based on the simulating of carrier excitation current amplitude and intermodulation signal coupling efficiency to calculate PIM level of metal contact in radiation field. By employing the slotted waveguide tooling based on near-field coupling test principle, we measured the third-order passive intermodulation (PIM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) level of the two copper wire contact junction located in the near-field radiation field of the slotted waveguide and analyzed its position distribution dependence. The experimental measured results are in good agreement with theoretical calculations, which validates the proposed calculation method of the PIM level induced by metallic contact junction in radiation field. This work provides an analytical method for its evaluating PIM products, and contributes to an in-depth understanding of the mechanism of PIM induced by metal contact in radiation field.

articleTitle: Multi-Bytes electromagnetic analysis: a novel method to get the key
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Conventional correlation electromagnetic analysis (CEMA) usually exploits electromagnetic power consumption of single byte. The leakage model only chooses single byte as the attacking target, while regarding the other bytes as noise. This means that conventional leakage model has abandoned most of the information that can be available. In order to take full advantage of information, we proposed a more effective method against AES-128 by using multi-bytes to extract the key. From the result of our experiment performed on Sakura-G, fewer traces were required by multi-bytes CEMA than single byte analysis to recover the entire key correctly.

articleTitle: Wideband RCS Reduction Matesurface Design
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this research, a new artificial magnetic conductor (AMC) surface based on optimized multielement phase cancellation (OMEPC) is proposed for wideband RCS reduction. The square ring patch was chosen as the basic AMC element of the metasurface for its reflection phase change characteristics. The OMEPC is used to optimize and select the appropriate parameters for unit cells. The proposed AMC surface can achieve 10 dB RCS reduction in a wideband from 10.80 to 22.06 GHz with 69% bandwidth. The theoretical analysis and simulation results are in good agreement and verify the ability and capability of the proposed mechanism.

articleTitle: A Modified Dynamic Deviation Reduction Based Volterra Model for Digital Predistortion of RF Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A modified dynamic deviation reduction (MDDR) based Volterra model for digital predistortion of power amplifiers is proposed in this paper. The MDDR model introduces the characteristics of generalized memory polynomial (GMP) model into dynamic deviation reduction (DDR) based Volterra model. Measurement results show that the MDDR model has better normalized mean-square error (NMSE) performance and adjacent channel power ratio (ACPR) performance than DDR model. And compare with GMP model, MDDR model has better NMSE performance and similar ACPR performance.

articleTitle: A Wide Bandgap Dielectric EBG Structure for Decoupling in Power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The characteristic of dielectric electromagnetic band gap (EBG) structure was studied for suppressing the electromagnetic noise in power distribution network (PDN), and the method, which divides a high dielectric constant (high-DK) cylinder into a high-DK film part and a conductive part, was proposed to extend the bandgap of dielectric EBG. The scattering parameters between two ports, located in a pair of power and ground planes, were simulated to evaluate the noise isolation performance for dielectric EBG structure and embedded capacitance respectively. The effects of the parameters such as relative permittivity and substrate thickness, and so on were analyzed. On the basis of the calculated results, a modified dielectric EBG structure was provided, which can be used for thick substrate of printed circuit board (PCB). Finally, the behavior of an EBG model for low frequency application is also studied. The obtained results show that the embedded capacitance has fine performance at a wide frequency range, but high dielectric constant and small thickness is required. Same as the embedded capacitance, the dielectric EBG is also in relation to the permittivity and thickness of dielectric material, however, it can more deeply suppress the noise within its forbidden frequency band. Moreover, the performance and application of dielectric EBG structure are enhanced using proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Ad hoc Network Communication in UAVs Formations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: As an important performance index of the UAV Ad hoc network, network reliability is a great significance for the performance evaluation of the UAV network system, and provides a direction for the selection of the UAVs formations. In this paper, based on the 3D Gauss Markov moving model, we modeled the motion mode of the UAV group. By using the Weibull distribution to sample the failure of the fleet, and through the correlation matrix which characterizes the connectivity state of network nodes in the time domain, we studied and compare the reliability of the self-organizing network of the UAV group with different formations. It provides a basis for selecting the formations of the UAVs for different network requirements.

articleTitle: A new electromagnetic radiation emission test system
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: To solve the problem of testing the electromagnetic radiation on-site in electromagnetic compatibility experiments of large electronic equipment, a new electromagnetic radiation test method was studied. Based on the adaptive cancellation method in time-frequency domain, an adaptive cancellation model in time-frequency domain was established and an electromagnetic radiation test system based on the modular instrument structure was proposed which is suitable for the model. The outdoor test results which was carried out with the test system showed that the electromagnetic radiation emission test system can effectively suppress the environmental electromagnetic interference, meanwhile, the radiation emission of electronic equipments can be tested outside very well.

articleTitle: Radio Wave Propagation Prediction Based on the NVIDIA OptiX GPU Ray Tracing Engine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the complexity of the large-area electromagnetic simulation environment and propose a method to accelerate the calculation process using the GPUs. The NVIDIA® OptiX™ engine is a ray tracing engine based on the GPUs hardware. It is mainly used for real-time graphics rendering, which has a good effect in the field of computer vision. Through the study of the OPtix engine, we mapped its methods and experience in the field of graphics rendering to electromagnetic simulation calculations. In the technology and principle, we look for the commonalities and differences between the two fields, and propose the feasibility of its application in the field of electromagnetic simulation. We successfully integrated it into the process of electromagnetic computing, and achieved the goal of reducing time overhead by using the parallel principle of the GPU and the acceleration algorithm of the engine.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Millimeter-wave Attenuators Using Periodic Series Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel millimeter-wave attenuator realized using a periodic series structure. The conventional attenuators are often connected by grounded via or shunt resistor stub, such as typical π or T -shaped attenuators. The disadvantage of them is the parasitic parameter produced by the grounded via or short/open stub when working at high frequency. To overcome it, a design method by only using a periodic series structure is proposed, which consists of periodic series resistors and quarter-wavelength transmission lines. The design theory is explained using an equivalent circuit model, and the equations of the theory are presented in details. A 3dB-attenuator working by 60GHz and a 5dB-attenuator working by 65GHz both based on ceramic substrate are designed, fabricated and measured. The results show high flatness of attenuation and return loss better than -15dB.

articleTitle: A fixture de-embedding method for material S-parameters measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The material S-parameter is one of the important parameters, for that it characterizes material electromagnetic properties like μ and ε. The fixture is usually used for the S-parameter measurement, but the fixture will cause the embedding error during the process of measurement. Thus, it is important that the embedding error should be eliminated for improving the S-parameter accuracy as more as possible. The measurement system is mapped into the cascade model of port network, and five states of cascade network are designed. Then, state equations can be built to solve fixture S-parameters problem. The result is proved that the proposed method of S-parameter de-embedding is feasible. And the simulation result shows that the maximum deviation between the calculated value and the physical simulated value is less than 2dB from 0.1 to 1.5 GHz.

articleTitle: A Simple Planar Microstrip Dual-Band Bandpass Filter with Multiple Transmission Zeros
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This thesis proposes a planar microstrip dual-band bandpass filter (BPF), which consists of four coupled-lines and a short-circuited stub. Scattering parameters of the presented dual-band BPF were discussed according to the even-and odd-mode network analysis theory and transmission line theory. Moreover, all of the transmission poles and transmission zeros were calculated mathematically. Two prototypes with different center frequency ratios (CFRs) were designed, fabricated, simulated, and measured. Finally, two dual-band BPFs with return loss higher than 15 dB in passbands and insertion loss higher than 10 dB in stopbands were obtained, which also had different CFRs as 1.96 and 2.38 respectively.

articleTitle: A Dual-Polarized Wide-Beamwidth Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna for the Fifth Generation Mobile Communications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-polarized wide-beamwidth magneto-electric (ME) dipole antenna for the fifth generation (5G) mobile communications is proposed. The proposed ME dipole antenna is printed on several dielectric substrates for easy fabrication. By applying a quadrate fence around the ME-dipole antenna, wide-beamwidth characteristics for both E- and H-planes can be obtained in dual linearly polarized directions. The proposed antenna realizes a half-power beamwidth (HPBW) of 129.1 ° in E-plane and another 100.4° in H-plane at 3.4 GHz, while 151.6° in E-plane and 94.2° in H-plane at 4.9 GHz can also be achieved. An overlapped impedance bandwidth (<; -10 dB) between the two ports of 63% (2.76-5.3 GHz) with gain of approximately 5 dBi can be attained.

articleTitle: A Conducted HEMP Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper designs a conductive HEMP pulse generator. The pulse generator is based on the Marx circuit structure, and is charged by a test transformer and a rectifier circuit, and a simple and stable trigger switch is designed. Simulation and testing show, the output pulse of generator is double exponential wave, which front edge time is about 20ns and the pulse width is about 600ns. By adjusting the switching air pressure and charging voltage, the output current peak is adjustable from 2.5 to 5 kA. The parameters basically meet the requirements of the standard.

articleTitle: Novel Design of Compact Antenna for Handheld RFID Readers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper proposes a small size antenna for portable RFID reader at the frequency of 2.45 GHz. A novel quadruple inverted-F antenna (QIFA) and a feed network with the same amplitude but different phases of each ports are presented. In addition, the QIFA is combined with a helical antenna for a compact size. The simulation results show that the proposed QIFA has a size of 20 × 20×8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> at 2.45 GHz, with the simulated 3-dB beamwidth more than 90°. The radiation efficiency of antenna is higher than 62% at 2.45 GHz and the total gain is 0.93 dB. This mentioned antenna can be a good choice for both handheld RFID devices and WLAN applications.

articleTitle: Application of System-Level EMC Design Technology in Microwave Remote Sensing Satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Characterized by wide frequency coverage, high power transmission and high sensitivity reception for the microwave remote sensing satellite, ninety-seven percent of the satellite devices cannot satisfy their standards or requirements in the receiving frequency band of payload, and the electromagnetic environment of the satellite is complicated. This paper mainly discusses the system level EMC design technology, including inhibiting the interference path, controlling the unexpected radiation emission of satellite products, and improving the shielding performance of cabin plates, to solve the interference problem, leading to a good electromagnetic compatibility for the satellite.

articleTitle: Development and Performance Test of SREMP Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: To the characteristics of the undertest SREMP electric field (rise time is shorter than 10ns, pulse width is wider than 1ms, field strength is higher than 100kV/m), a series of wide pulse and high field strength measurement systems were developed in the paper by theoretical analysis, simulation and circuit design. Performance test results show that the measurement system's rise time response is shorter than 5ns, and pulse width response is wider than 1ms. The dynamic range of measurement system is wider than 50dB, and the field strength measurement capability can be extended from 30V/m to1000kV/m. Using the developed series measurement systems interdependently, the pulsed electric field can be tested reliably.

articleTitle: Design of Millimeter-wave Transmitter Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, millimeter-wave transmitter based on FPGA is designed. The transmitter consists of intermediate frequency (IF) module, local oscillator (LO) module and mixing module. The IF module consists of an FPGA and two DACs, FPGA and DAC communicate through the JESD204B protocol to output multi-channel IF signals. The LO module is a VCO evaluation board that provides LO signal for mixing module. The mixing module is a PCB board that mainly includes four mixers and a power divider. The mixing module uses LO signal to upconvert IF signal to the millimeter-wave band. Tests show that the FPGA can realize the phase adjustment of digital baseband signal. The DAC can adjust the frequency of IF signal by numerically controlled oscillator (NCO). The mixing module can upconvert IF signal to millimeter-wave band. The transmitter designed in this paper can be applied to the 5G millimeter-wave antenna array.

articleTitle: Individual Identification of Electronic Equipment Based on Turn-on Transient Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method of classifying and identifying Individual electronic devices by recognizing transient Turn-on signal based on machine learning technology, which has significant applications in electronic equipment monitoring system. In the research, four different electronic devices are selected as the radiation sources, whose Turn-on signals, 4961 samples in total, acquired and then analyzed by six classifiers. As separating 4961 transient signals from raw signals is difficult, an effective signal segment interception algorithm based on sliding window adaptive variance is proposed. Besides, we also construct a hybrid template of features, which contains 38 features in total. Then, send the template to six models for training, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT), Linear Discriminant Analysis(LDA), Decision Tree(DT) and Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost). The average accuracy rate of the six models is 96.21%. Finally, a hard voting method adopted indicating that it not only increases the average accuracy rate to 97.91% but also improves the stability of the system with a few samples.

articleTitle: Design of Long-periods Electromagnetic Interference Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, we study an observation system for electromagnetic interference measurement for during the electrical systems with long-term uninterrupted power supply. Firstly, a simple and efficient long-term electromagnetic interference measurement system based on electromagne tic compatibility standard instruments and programming in Lab Viewis proposed This system can able to obtain time domain and frequency domain electromagnetic interference without manual intervention at the same time. Moreover, by tested and verified, this system works stably and meet the monitoring requirements of electromagnetic interference measurement with automated. This system has good support for the construction of inteUigent electromagnetic compatibility laboratory for better versatility and scalability.

articleTitle: A Air-Gaps-Slotted SIW Horn Antenna With Partially Detached Broad Walls
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a air-gaps-slotted substrate-integrated waveguide(SIW) horn antenna with partially detached broad walls is proposed. Five groups of air gaps with gradually varying widths were slotted to make the dielectric constant of the substrate change along the radiation direction, which effectively improving the impedance matching characteristics of the antenna and significantly increasing the gain of the antenna. In the frequency range of 19.6GHz ~ 35GHz, |S11| of the antenna is less than -10dB, and the maximum gain is 10.4dBi.

articleTitle: Spoof Plasmon Resonance with Terahertz 1-D Periodic Rectangular Filled Refractive Index Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The dispersion properties of spoof surface plasmon polaritons with 1D rectangular groove structure by analytical solution and numerical solution respectively is analyzed, and the FEM method was used to simulate the refractive index sensing of SPR in terahertz band in an Otto configuration. From the simulation results, we can see that the 1D periodic groove has strong field constraint ability in THz regime as well as in optical band, and the variation of reflection coefficient with incident angle and frequency is very sensitive to the refractive index of the analyte. These results provide a new approach to sample detection and THz regime refractive index sensing, which has great advantages in biomedical tissue detection and sample detection in the future.

articleTitle: A Low Mutual Coupling SRR-inspired Monopole MIMO Antenna by Exploiting Stub and Slot Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this letter, a low mutual coupling wideband multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) antenna is designed on an FR4 substrate (37×32 × 1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>), The proposed MIMO antenna covers the band of 3.2-5.7 GHz with an isolation of higher than 19 dB. The initial MIMO antenna consists of two monopoles, and then a split-ring resonator (SRR) is loaded surrounding the monopole. The SRR is inspired and interacts with the monopole, which enhances the bandwidth. By introducing a stub and a A/4 narrow slot on the ground, the mutual coupling between the elements is reduced. The envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) obtained from complex radiation patterns is lower than 0.03, which ensures a good MIMO performance.

articleTitle: Effect Analysis of Electrode Moving Velocity and Polarity in Non-contact Electrostatic Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Based on the speed effect detector of electrode motion to the target developed by our team independently, multiple experiments have been exerted repeatedly under the condition of changing moving speed of the electrode and changing polarity of the discharge electrode. Exploring based on analysis of the experimental data was conducted for obtaining the relationship between parameters of peak discharge current, rise time and polarity of discharge electrode. The results shown that, at charged voltage to be positive 3kV, or negative 3kV, the peak voltage of discharge current at positive polarity is distinguished higher than that at negative polarity. The rising speed of discharge current pulse in negative polarity, at the same time, is clearly less than that in positive polarity. The work finished in this paper may benefit to promoting research on the test standard of non-contact electrostatic discharge.

articleTitle: Electrically Actuated Beam Steering Reconfigurable Vivaldi Antenna With Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a beam steering Vivaldi antenna based on the displacement of liquid metal elements is presented. The proposed antenna consists of a Vivaldi antenna, three fluidic channels and three liquid metal elements. In order to control the liquid metal slugs, three fluidic channels are placed in front of Vivaldi antenna's aperture. The antenna's beam can be steered by changing the position of liquid metal slugs. Here, the positioning of liquid metal slugs is achieved by using continuous electrowetting (CEW) actuation. The proposed antenna beam can be steered from -30° to 30°. The antenna operates in the frequency band of 4.8-4.9 GHz. The half power beam width (HPBW) for main lobe in 0°, 10°, 20° and 30° are 38.5°, 25.5°, 21.8°, and 21.1 ° respectively.

articleTitle: Domain Information Acquiring with A Text Analysis System On Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Large amounts of unstructured documents are collected for data tasks or information studies in many fields. The analysis and study for these domain texts become the fundamental issue for domain information acquiring. In this paper, a web-based platform for text distributed computing of Hadoop are constructed, technologies of Spring Boot framework and node.js etc. web front-end techniques, distributing computing and text analysis are integrated for domain text processing. Documents are pre-processing for text analysis, Chinese segmented with the open source tool of IKAnalyzer is implemented. Our system is a good practice for the process of text gathering, filtering, distributed computing, analysis and results visualization. Documents from an educational investigation upload in the system, thousands of school office documents in Guizhou rural villages and towns can be dealing directly and get a quick look for the issue. Meanwhile, other documents such as EMC conference proceedings can follow the pipeline for knowledge discovery with this platform.

articleTitle: Optimized design of the flexible stepped impedance lowpass filter based on defected ground structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Since the performances of the common flexible microstrip filters change in bending state, this paper applies rectangular defected ground structure (DGS) units to reduce the change. The proposed filter which is designed on a polyimide substrate consists of the stepped impedance structure and the rectangular DGS units. Simulation results demonstrate that the designed flexible lowpass filter has 30% to 83% smaller cutoff frequency offset in bending state compared with the common stepped impedance lowpass filter. At the same time, the insertion loss and the return loss in the passband maintain original level after the circuit is bent. The outband suppression changes within limited range.

articleTitle: Study on Subharmonics in a Flyback Converter Considering Transformer Inductance and Parasite Capacitance of Switching Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents the subharmonics phenomenon of switching frequency in a flyback converter (FBC). Discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) and continuous conduction mode (CCM) are interleaving, which generates 1/2, 3/2, 5/2... switching frequency subharmonics. The subharmonics are related to the oscillation between the transformer inductance and the parasite capacitance of the switching device. Numerical analysis validates the subharmonic phenomenon in a 132 kHz 15 W FBC, the analysis results suggest that the subharmonics are minimum when the primary and equivalent secondary side leakage impedances are equal in the transformer.

articleTitle: Pattern-Reconfigurable Patch Antenna Using Liquid Metal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A concept for pattern-reconfigurable patch antenna with parasitic elements is presentedin this paper. The proposed pattern-reconfigurable antenna mainly consists of a central circular patch and eight surrounding fan ring parasitic patches. With the position of liquid metal slug in a microfluidic channel changed, one of eight parasitic patches is connected to the central patch, the designed antenna working at resonant frequencies of 5.338GHz can realize reconfigurability of the main beam in eight directions with 45° steps in the azimuth plane and a vertical tilting angle of 42°. Each of the main lobes at eight directions has a simulated beamwidth of about 118.4° and a maximum simulated gain of about 6.16 dB, the concept can realize 360° full-range scan around zenith axis.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experiment Study on Overhead Lines Coupling Effect Under Gas Discharge
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The simulation and experiment of field-to-line are of interest among researchers on high-voltage engineering and lightning study. In this study, the coupling effect of overhead line is analyzed by numerical simulation and experiment. First, a gap discharge coupling experiment system was built under laboratory conditions. The coupling current measured on the terminal of overhead line is 0.92 A. Then, the Agrawal equivalent model is established and solved by Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method. The calculated results of terminal coupling current and voltage on overhead line are 4.26 A and 2.13 V, respectively. The current waveform yielded by numerical simulation agrees well with the measured one, indicating that the simulation model is reliable. Finally, the relationship between the coupling current at the terminal of the overhead line and load is discussed.

articleTitle: Simplified Expressions of Cloud Lightning Electromagnetic Fields Produced by Vertical Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In order to meet the actual demand of cloud lightning channel current inversion, a theoretical calculation model of lightning electromagnetic fields produced by vertical cloud lightning channel is established based on the dipole method, and the simplified relationship between the cloud lightning electromagnetic field at ground level from the vertical channel and the channel current is presented. By comparing the cloud lightning electromagnetic fields from the simplified expressions with that from the exact expressions, the influences of the observation distance, the channel length and the channel starting height on the accuracy of the simplified expressions are obtained, and the application ranges of the simplified expressions are also given.

articleTitle: Quick Switching Overhead Micro-Heater Switch Structure Based GeTe Phase Change
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel quick switch RF phase change switch structure is presented. An indirect heated micro-heater is patterned on the top of phase change material, separated by dielectric barrier. The fabrication process is simplified due to the absence of micro-heater embedding and the phase transition is accelerated due to the optimization of heat transfer structure. The simulation results show that the time of heating and quenching process is 18.86ns and 49.25ns respectively, the time is shortened by 8.49ns and 9.48ns respectively compared with the existing structure, and the insertion loss <; 0.75dB and the isolation >12dB across a frequency range from 1GHz to 40GHz.

articleTitle: Passive Intermodulation Suppression of PIFA by EGaIn as Reconfigurable Normal Temperature Solder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Contact nonlinearity is one of the considerable reasons for the generation of passive intermodulation (PIM) signal in RF devices and circuits. Based on the analysis of contact junctions in planar inverted F antenna (PIFA), a method of PIM suppression using liquid Ga-In alloy (EGaIn) is proposed. EGaIn is different from traditional soldering tin, which can realize stable reconfigurable connection of contact junction position at room temperature. Particularly, we firstly analyze the circuit model of contact junction under radio frequency (RF). Then, a PIFA operating at 2.6 GHz is designed and implemented. Finally, we compared the intermodulation index of the PIFA before and after EGaIn welding, in which the maximum difference was 40 dB. This paper authenticates that EGaIn can reconfigurably weld the contact junction position of PIFA at room temperature, which provides a reference method for the nonlinear suppression scheme in electrical connection.

articleTitle: $L_{\frac{1}{2}}$ Regularization and Reweighted $L_{\frac{1}{2}}$ Regularization on ISAR Image Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper implements the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> regularization and reweighted L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> regularization on the reconstruction of ISAR image under down sampling rate. The results specify that the reweighted L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> regularization performs better than L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> regularization and performs equally with L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> regularization.

articleTitle: A Low-profile Broadband Balun Fed Circular Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A low-profile broadband circular patch antenna that can excite TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>and TM12 modes is proposed. The proposed antenna mainly consists of an annular slotted circular radiation patch, a metal ground, a set of shorting pins, and a vertical grounded balun feeding structure. One side of the vertical feeding substrate is slotted ground and the other side is a microstrip feeding line. A cross-shaped slot is introduced on the circular radiation patch, it improves the impedance matching of the antenna significantly. With a profile of 0.063 λ0 (λ0 is the center operating wavelength in the free space), the -10 dB impedance operating band is 3.49-5.5 GHz and the relative bandwidth is 44.7%.

articleTitle: Discussion on Lightning Protection Design of Aerospace Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Since the 1969 Apollo 12 lightning strike incident, aerospace engineers have gradually realized of the importance of lightning protection for aerospace transportation system. Since then, lightning protection technology has been greatly developed. Until now, the United Stated and Russia both establish their own lightning protection design program and specifications. In the recent the Soyuz lightning strike incident, people can obviously find that the lightning current was thoroughly flowed away the whole launch vehicle when lightning strike to the launch vehicle, but the Soyuz stand the strong lightning current and lightning environment without any damage or hardware degrade, and successfully complete the launch mission, which indicated that the Soyuz takes lightning protection design on its design process and it achieves a high lightning protection performance. This paper takes launch vehicle as the discussion object, tracks some typical lightning strike incidents, and discusses the lightning protection design for aerospace transportation system both in the United State and Russia, which may provide enlightenment and ideas for lightning protection design of China's aerospace transportation system.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Individual Identification of Radio Frequency Circuits after TID
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The individual identification method of the irradiated RF circuits is proposed based on deep learning technology. In order to identify the same RF circuit under different conditions of TID (Total Ionizing Dosem), the deep residual network architecture is built. So that, the recognition results can be used for the research of the TID and damage mechanism of RF circuits, while the actual space exposure times can be estimated. At last, the RF circuits with same type are irradiated with different doses of radiation, and the residual network is used to estimate the actual space exposure years of these circuits, with the accuracy more than 83.92%.

articleTitle: Investigation on Shielding Effectiveness Measurement Technology of Frequency Stirring Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The reverberation chamber is an electromagnetic compatibility measurement site. It achieves the desired field distribution characteristics by using the rotation of metal stir, which has the defects of complex testing device and long testing cycle. In this paper, a method of frequency stirring reverberation chamber is proposed, and the effectiveness of frequency stirring is verified by simulation calculation and experimental measurement. The shielding effectiveness of the shell of a small VAV is measured by this method. And the results show that the frequency stirring reverberation chamber could got the statistics of the electromagnetic field in the shell of the VAV, and the shielding effectiveness of the enclosure in the 1~10GHz band was about 8~10dB. The probability that the deviation of different measuring positions less than 3dB was 94%.

articleTitle: Compact, Low-Profile, Planar Filtering Antennas Based on A Novel Coupling Feeding Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The compact, low-profile linearly polarized (LP) and circularly polarized (CP) filtering antennas based on a novel feed scheme are presented. The LP design consists of a patch and an inverted-h-shaped coupling feed probe, which can introduce two radiation nulls at the lower and the upper band edges to realize a quasi-elliptic bandpass filtering response, respectively. This LP design with simple feed structure is also extended to realize the CP function by adding an extra T -shaped feedline operating as a dual-mode resonator, while maintaining the excellent filtering performance and further enhancing the impedance bandwidth. For demonstration, two prototypes of the LP and CP designs were measured. The measured results agree well with the simulated values. In addition, good performance characteristics, i.e., flat passband gain response, excellent roll-off rate, and high out-of-band suppression level, could be well achieved.

articleTitle: A New Setup of the CISPR 25 ALSE Performance Validation from 30 MHz to 200 MHz
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The test site setup from 30 MHz to 200 MHz of Absorber Lined Shielded Enclosure (ALSE) performance validation of the CISPR 25 [1] is improved and optimized in this paper. By effectively grounding to the test bench, the scattering resonance in radiation emission measurement of vehicle parts is resolved. The setup of the test site is modeled by full-wave simulation software. Additionally, with the back edge of the test bench is grounded, both the front edge and the two side edges and are grounded separately. The simulation results and exploring test show that grounding at the front edge of the test bench can better suppress the scattering resonance and reduce the defined tolerance of the CISPR 25 to 5 dB creatively. The new test site setup improves the reliability, the accuracy and the consistency in the radiation emission measurement.

articleTitle: A X-Band Linearized LNA with Low Power Post-Distortion Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A X-Band linearized low noise amplifier is presented in a 130 nm CMOS process. The modified post-distortion technique is employed to reduce the extra power consumption and improve the linearity. In this design, the LNA with an unsaturated auxiliary NMOS transistor achieves the suppression of the nonlinearity. Two-stage common source network is used to enhance the gain and achieves X-band bandwidth in the proposed LNA. With low extra 0.07 mW power consumption of the post-distortion network, the simulated results of the implemented LNA show that IIP3 has been boosted to -5~3.55 dBm in the range of 8-12 GHz. The LNA has a peak gain of 14.3 dB and a minimum noise figure of 1.86 dB. It consumes a total 5.79 mW power consumption from a 600 mV supply voltage. The total chip area is 0.69 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Tunable Band-stop Filter for Radiation Emission Test of Railway Locomotive Radio
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper designs a tunable narrow-band bandstop filter for radiation emission (RE) test of 450 MHz railway locomotive radio. The loading capacitance of the cavity is changed by the screw, and the center frequency of the band rejection filter is adjustable from 457.9 MHz to 467.9 MHz. Its narrow bandwidth is achieved by weak coupling between the main transmission and the cavity, and the stopband bandwidth can be adjusted by the coupling distance. When the center frequency changes, the stopband bandwidth remains the same with a 30 dB rejection bandwidth of 0.8 MHz. Using Step impedance resonator (SIR) structure, its volume is only half of the traditional cavity band stop filter, and its spurious stop-band is higher than 2 GHz, while the quality factor (Q-value) is very high, and its passband insertion loss is less than 1 dB.

articleTitle: Lightning protection of the dedicated transformer for radio base station
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper deals with lightning protection of the dedicated transformer for Radio Base Station (RBS). The main objective is to reduce risk of damage to RBS dedicated transformer due to lightning flashes, which will improve the safety and reliability of the RBS itself and its related equipment.

articleTitle: Time Efficient Conducted EMI Prediction for a Flyback Converter with Control Optimization by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: Most conducted EMI prediction for switching mode power supply adopts time domain simulation, the transient process establishing the output voltage takes large part of the simulation time. The appropriate control parameters can reduce the system overshoot and adjustment time, thus shorten the simulation time. Take the flyback converter as the research object, the genetic algorithm (GA) with global optimization advantage is used to optimize the classical PID control parameters. The simulation results show that the optimized PID control has lower overshoot and adjustment time than the traditional PID control, shortens the simulation time effectively while maintaining the accuracy of conducted EMI prediction.

articleTitle: Coupling Current Simulation: Closed Cables under Electric Field Simulator for Near Strike Lightning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The electromagnetic interference caused by nearby lightning strikes poses a real threat to the electronic systems. This paper analyzed the coupling current of closed cables in lightning electromagnetic environment using CST, and the experimental validation was carried out with the electric field simulator for near strike lightning. The results showed that the magnitude of the coupling current was proportional to the change rate of the electric field, and for a rectangular closed cable with a size of 40×115 cm, the coupling current under simulator can reach to several amperes.

articleTitle: A Compact High Efficiency PA Based on Thin-film Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a compact internally-matched power amplifier (PA) worked from 2.5 GHz to 3.6 GHz. Using high dielectric constant substrate (thin-film) as impedance matching circuit, smaller size, cost reduction and performance improvement have been achieved. The size of the internally-matched PA is 27×10 mm. The simulated results of output power, gain and drain efficiency(DE) are over 42.4 dBm, 11.7 dB and 62% respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation experiment of Inductive electric field measurement of Needle-ball electrode based on CST Microwave Studio
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In recent years, UWB technology has gradually been widely used in many fields such as wireless communication, radar, positioning and electromagnetic pulse weapons. At the same time, it also plays an important role in ground radiation experiments such as aerospace. But in the experiment of electromagnetic radiation irradiation with UWB electromagnetic pulse, it is difficult to measure quantitatively. At the same time, it is disturbed by various factors and the measurement error is large. This paper simulates the UWB EMP signal by CST-MWS software and radiates the needle-ball electrodes. Through simulation calculation, it is found that there is a certain correlation between the induced voltage and electric field intensity between the electrodes of EMP and the intensity of EMP and the size of the electrodes. (Abstract)

articleTitle: An effective permittivity based new model for calculating cloud attenuation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The millimeter wave and terahertz wave produce severe attenuation while passing through the cloud. The commonly used calculation models are obtained by fitting massive measurement data. However, this kind of model has limitations, such as no solid theoretical foundation and the need for large amounts of data. When significant climate change occurs, the data need to be remeasured for fitting. In this paper, based on effective permittivity of mixtures, a new theoretical model of cloud attenuation theory is proposed, which realizes the theoretical calculation of cloud attenuation. The new model is more accurate and more applicable compared with existing models.

articleTitle: Design of a Broadband GaN Power Amplifier with a Novel Harmonic-Tuned Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: This paper presents a bandwidth enhanced GaN power amplifier (PA) for future communications. A dual transmission line structure is employed in the second harmonic-tuned network to improve the efficiency of the proposed power amplifier. Fundamental matching network (FMN) is based on the stepped transmission-line sections with different characteristic impedances. For demonstration, a PA based on Cree CGH40010 GaN HEMT is simulated and measured. The simulated results show that a 60.2%-78.9% drain efficiency (DE) is achieved, while the saturation power gain is larger than 10 dB from 220 MHz to 1540 MHz. Meanwhile, the measured drain efficiency reachs 56 %-68 % with a corresponding gain of over 10 dB under continuous wave signal test.

articleTitle: Design of the ADC/DAC Circuit based on Electromagnetic Compatibility
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In order to improve the conversion accuracy of high speed ADC/DAC, the IBIS model of the analog-to-digital converter AD9433 is simulated, the output impedance of the IBIS model is obtained and impedance matching is performed, which reduces the overshoot during the transmission. The influence of crosstalk between transmission lines is obtained through the simulation of crosstalk between transmission lines. According to the above analysis, ADC/DAC circuit is designed by analog-to-digital converter AD9433 and digital-to-analog converter AD9706. It was verified with a FPGA control board. The interference source data which acquired by the oscilloscope and field probes has been analyzed. Though filtering the clock signal, isolating digital signal lines, disposing power supply line, this paper solves the electromagnetic compatibility problem of ADC/DAC circuit, and the output waveform is obtained under the requirements.

articleTitle: Device-to-Device Channel Modeling and Spacetime Correlation Analysis Based on Uniform Circular Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: With the implementation of the fifth generation (5G) communication technology, the Device-to-Device (D2D) channel at millimeter wave (mm wave) frequencies is urgently required due to its flexibility in multi-scene applications. In this paper, we first propose a three-dimensional (3D) two-cylinder geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) for D2D channel, which is equipped with uniform circular arrays (UCAs). Based on the model, the space-time correlation expression is derived. Then, we analyze the influence of different parameters on space and time correlation of D2D channel at mm wave frequencies. These parameters are: the number of antenna elements, the azimuth placement angles of antenna, the UCAs radius, and time delay. We also verify the reliability of proposed model by comparing the measurements data. All results will be available for D2D mm wave channel system design in the future.

articleTitle: An Anti-Electromagnetic Interference Simulation Platform for Navigation Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The main work of this paper is to build a simulation platform for studying the anti-electromagnetic interference problem of navigation receiver.
