The simulation platform includes multi-array antenna simulation module, direction of arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm, adaptive spatial filtering algorithm module and interface file reading and writing module. Aiming at the problem that the satellite signal is submerged in the interference and causing subsequent tracking and solving failure, the mode space conversion method is adopted to make the ESPRIT algorithm applicable to the uniform circular array(UCA), realizing the spatial signal two-dimensional DOA estimation, and adopting the linear constrained minimum variance criterion (LCMV) performs adaptive spatial filtering to achieve anti-jamming purposes. The simulation platform can flexibly set parameters such as the number of array elements, satellite signals and interference, which greatly facilitates the research on the anti-electromagnetic interference problem of the navigation receiver.

articleTitle: Modified Magnitude-Selective Affine Function-Based Digital Predistorter for Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A modified magnitude-selective affine function-based (M-MSA) model is proposed for radio frequency power amplifier in this paper. Using linear term and second-order terms, the model replaces the first-order term and the second-order term with phase in the I-MSA model, eliminating the coordinate rotation digital computer (CORDIC) algorithm and decreasing the number of coefficients by (M+1)K. Complexity of the proposed model is lower than the I-MSA model, and the model coefficients are extracted by the least-square method A 4-carrier long-term evolution (LTE) signal of 20MHz bandwidth is used as the excitation in the experiment. The experimental results show that the M-MSA model have nearly the same adjacent channel power ratio (ACPR) and normalized mean square error (NMSE) as the I-MSA model, and the M-MSA model has lower hardware complexity and higher operating efficiency.

articleTitle: A Design of 4×4 Microstrip Slot Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: A 4×4 slot antenna array is designed. The overall dimension of the antenna array is 176mm×176mm×1mm. The top surface of the ground with 4×4 slots is printed on a F4BM dielectric substrate with a thickness of 1mm. The base surface of the substrate is the feeding network. The antenna radiates in the axial direction with a 4mm thick metal substrate attached to the bottom of the feeding network. The working frequency of the antenna array is 3.83-3.99GHz, and gain is 13.41dBi. The simulation results show that the radiation characteristics of the antenna array are good.

articleTitle: Individual Identification of Electronic Equipment Based on Electromagnetic Fingerprint Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The individual identification of electronic equipment is mainly based on the characteristics of different electronic equipment hardware transmitting signals to identify which communication equipment the signal comes from and realize equipment tracking. The contents of this paper include the following aspects:(1) A fingerprint extraction method based on histogram and signal level co-occurrence matrix (SLCM) is proposed. A relatively complete signal feature library is established combined with other signal characteristics, which can be used as signal fingerprint template for individual identification. (2) Starting point detection based on mean sliding window is proposed to detect the effective signal segment from the continuous signal stream and improve the recognition rate. The experiment of individual recognition is carried out by integrating several base classifiers and the final accuracy of the model is up to 98% and solved the problem of individual identification of the same type of communication equipment under the condition of small sample, low signal-to-noise ratio and varying signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Environment RF Power Harvesting in IoT: A Resent Review
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: As a kind of environment power harvesting technology, RF energy harvesting has drawn attention in the beginning of this century. This paper is a brief summarization of resent RF energy harvesting researches. Firstly, the structure of the RF power harvesting system is introduced. Then the implementation of every module is discussed, including the improvement of the power harvesting antenna, design of the matching circuit, several types of rectifier and the design of power manage module. Some solutions to the problems faced by RF power harvesting system are discussed in this paper. At last, the solutions and research directions are summed up to be a reference for the future researches.

articleTitle: Research on the Induced Current Distribution Law of the Penetrative Conductor under the Condition of the Continuous Wave Radiation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: The penetrative conductor is the most important coupling channel of bring the outside electromagnetic radiated field into the metal shielded box. In order to disclose the electromagnetic radiation coupling law of the penetrative conductor and the generation mechanism of the local electromagnetic field enhancement effect in shielded box caused by the penetrative conductor coupling, the induced current distribution law of the penetrative conductor under the condition of sine continuous wave radiation is studied in this paper. The penetrative conductor induced current distribution computation model is established under the condition of plane wave radiation. The analytic expression of the induced current distribution is derived. The penetrative conductor induced current amplitude distribution curve is plotted by using Matlab software at typical frequency point. The penetrative conductor induced current distribution law versus radiated frequency and conductor location is disclosed under the condition of plane wave radiation. The penetrative conductor induced current test platform based on vector network analyzer is developed by adopting current probe and optical fiber signal transmission system. The normalized induced current distribution curve at typical frequency point is measured. The test results verify the correctness of the penetrative conductor induced current distribution law and other theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: A Study on the Passive Intermodulation Induced by the Thermal Effect of Electrical Contact in Microwave Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 6th International Symposium on Electromagnetic Compatibility (ISEMC)
abstract: In communication systems, the nonlinear effect of waveguide flanges, coaxial connectors, antennas and other passive devices produces passive intermodulation (PIM). The mechanism for the nonlinear effect of the PIM is very complicated, which mainly comes from two sources: contact nonlinearity and material nonlinearity. PIM caused by contact nonlinearity at metal junctions of microwave devices is studied in this paper. According to the geometrical configuration and mechanical properties to characterize the contact surface, and the mechanical model of the metal contact surface is established. The microscopic physical effect of metal contact surfaces is analyzed and the equivalent circuit model is obtained. Moreover, the power series model is used to describe the nonlinear voltage-current relationship in the circuit. The model is verified by two-tone simulation, and the spectrum characteristics of PIM are obtained. Finally, the multi-carrier simulation of the equivalent circuit combined with the search method is conducted, predicting the intermodulation products under multi-carrier quickly and accurately.
